techno.name: Techno
techno.description: Driving 909 kick, a rolling acid bass and echoing stabs – straight ahead, full speed.

lofi.name: Lo-Fi Hip-Hop
lofi.description: A relaxed, dusty beat with warm jazz chords – music to study to.

house.name: House
house.description: Four-to-the-floor, offbeat chords and a bouncy bass – pure club feeling.

ambient.name: Ambient
ambient.description: Floating pads, sparkling echoes and lots of space – made for drifting away.

synthwave.name: Synthwave
synthwave.description: Neon 80s: a pumping eighth-note bass, wide supersaw chords and a retro lead.

chiprock.name: 16-Bit Rock
chiprock.description: Rock in 16-bit style: a bouncing octave bass, square stabs, an echoing lead and bitcrushed grit.
